prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached existing warm brown bear mascot from the WayMate travel companion app. Create its replacement character, retaining the same polished, friendly high-end 3D animated mascot rendering, tactile short velvety fur, full-body cutout, gentle studio lighting, and joyful welcoming personality. Change the animal identity completely.
Primary request: a new original adorable long-eared little creature with the comforting appeal of Terriermon: an oversized round cream/ivory head and tiny plump body, exceptionally long soft floppy ears spreading gently outward and then drooping down, soft sage/mint green ear tips and inner ears, tiny mitten paws and rounded feet. Give it its own clear identity: two little leaf-shaped mint forelocks rather than a horn, warm dark chocolate oval eyes with clean highlights, a tiny cocoa nose, a sweet open smiling mouth with a small pink tongue, subtle peach blush. The ear silhouette should feel distinctive and pet-like, with a very slight asymmetry and generous natural soft curves. Preserve the bear's small sage green neck scarf as a restrained travel-friend cue, but make it a simple small tied kerchief that does not hide the torso. One paw raised in a little welcoming wave and the other resting by its belly. It is standing on two feet, body turned just slightly three-quarter but face looking directly at the viewer. Cute without being a baby toy; calm, huggable and expressive enough to accompany a driver.
Composition: exactly ONE character, full body visible including both very long ears and both feet, generous clean 8% transparent margin all around. Large simple readable silhouette suitable on a small mobile screen. Centered square app asset, no cropping, no scene, no props around it, no floor, no cast shadow rectangle. High quality material definition, clean consistent anatomy, two arms and two legs only, precisely two ears. Not a brown bear. Keep the 3D visual sophistication and texture quality of the input.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, including between arms and torso and around ears. No checkerboard baked in, no gradient, no white background, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark.
